context: Evaluates whether the candidate correctly configures the Kibo Commerce API for server-side use, including OAuth client credentials authentication via APIAuthenticationHelper and the correct wiring of the GraphQL fetcher. Tests knowledge of the KiboCommerceConfig interface and required environment variable mappings.

checklist.name: Uses package config factory
checklist.description: The module uses the Kibo Commerce package's configuration factory or createCommerceProvider setup rather than building a raw HTTP client from scratch.

checklist.name: All required env vars mapped
checklist.description: commerceUrl (KIBO_API_URL), clientId (KIBO_CLIENT_ID), sharedSecret (KIBO_SHARED_SECRET), and authUrl (KIBO_AUTH_URL) are all read from environment variables.

checklist.name: cartCookie default fallback
checklist.description: The cartCookie value uses KIBO_CART_COOKIE with a fallback to 'kibo_cart' when the env var is not set.

checklist.name: Package GraphQL fetcher used
checklist.description: The fetch field in the config uses the package-provided GraphQL fetcher (fetchGraphqlApi or equivalent), not a plain fetch or third-party HTTP client.

checklist.name: customerCookie configured
checklist.description: The customerCookie is supplied from the KIBO_CUSTOMER_COOKIE environment variable.
